findings: The v 08440 addendum correctly leaves 00431/00812 numbers pending; now supply 6 clearly scoped primary evidence records.
Existing 00431 primary evidence numbers are broadly correct, but original and final analyses need separate identification; the originalPFSHR interval is 99.5%CI.
Legacy 00431 patient-selection text statesECOG 0–1 and symptomaticILD exclusion; current NCCPv 11 hasECOG 0–2 andILD caution.
Original cemiplimab 47% response was 3 mg/kgq 2 weeks metastaticgroup 1, not the current 350 mgq 3 weeks schedule. Exact fixed-dose metastatic cohort has 41.1% independentORR at 8.1 months.
Current EMAadjuvantCSCC indication does not establish NCCPv 3 a adjuvant support or Irish reimbursement.
validation: All numeric efficacy claims tied to a named primary-study cohort, assessor and analysis.
No HCC, cervical or adjuvant effect size transferred into skin context.
No survival advantage computed from single-armCSCC data.
Existing CNS evidence preserved as contextual; no randomised cohort comparison claimed.
limits: This is primary-source reconciliation, not independent oncology/pharmacy approval.
No broad search for every newer melanoma/CSCC treatment was undertaken; historical pivotal analyses are labelled with their dates.
NCCP source rules still govern current schedule, eligibility and thresholds.

PubMed sometimes returned a minimal/error page on open; original 2015 andCheckMate 204 abstract content was verified through the officialPubMed search result, with accessiblePMC manuscripts used for other studies.
